scope: All ten oracle PNGs viewed individually at native resolution after 1600x700 contact; no learned model inference
decision: Only two of six declared training pairs judged sufficient for exploratory reconstruction, below predeclared minimum four. Do not start editor training on this supervision. No model/trainer implemented.
mask_semantics: Existing masks were approved as loss support, not production hard composites. Exact protected-pixel copying is numerically satisfied but boundary plausibility fails.
new_user_constraints: Below 500ms server generation; GPU hosting now allowed. No latency claim established.
